name: Startup Fast

sources.title: Startup Fast submit/pricing — Free vs Premium launch tiers

conditions: Free launch requires displaying their badge on your website
Free queue: only 5 slots/day, launches can take up to 90 days
The free tier's dofollow backlink is conditional: must rank Top 3 on launch day AND keep the badge displayed
requirements: Sign-in required (Sign in / Sign up links; submit routes to /projects/submit)
All launches go live at 8:00 AM UTC
Site is built on the open-source Open Launch platform
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, logo, category
Badge HTML for the free path (badge options at /legal/badges)
A plan for launch-day votes if you want the free tier's dofollow link (Top-3 requirement)
workflow: Choose Free Launch ($0, up to ~90 days out) or Premium ($19/launch, within ~30 days, 12 daily slots)
Schedule into an available launch day (8:00 AM UTC drops)
On free: display the badge and push for Top-3 votes on launch day to earn the dofollow link
Premium guarantees the dofollow backlink with no badge
watchFor: The free 'dofollow backlink' is a competition prize, not a guarantee — Top 3 on launch day plus the badge; most free launches likely earn neither
Free vs Premium is the badge + queue + guaranteed-link trade; sponsorships ($49/mo or $399/yr, capped at 5 slots/month) are separate
Official agent path exists: 'npx skills add https://github.com/zreren/startupfast-publish' — install the publish skill before an agent-driven submission
Stripe Climate badge indicates Stripe checkout
countsAsLive: The product appears on the homepage/directory on its scheduled 8:00 AM UTC launch day with its own project page.
unknowns: How ties/rank for the Top-3 dofollow condition are decided
Whether failed-to-rank free listings keep any link (likely nofollow — not stated)
